english.title: Cause a motor vehicle to be towed without approved equipment within a Mersey Tunnel
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the driver of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), within the Mersey Tunnels, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TUNNEL..), caused the vehicle to be towed through the tunnels without being provided with towing equipment which was approved by a Mersey Tunnels police officer or other authorised officer as sufficient for the purpose
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 3(h) and 16 of the Mersey Tunnels Byelaws 2003.
